verdict.rationale: Docs mention a 'generated OpenAPI client' for searching/listing Bazaar resources (docs-22) and CDP exposes an llms.txt machine-readable documentation index (probe-1, probe-2), but a direct probe for standard OpenAPI/swagger spec URLs on the docs domain returned 404s (probe-3), so no confirmed downloadable spec file was found. Missing for 10: a verifiably downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger JSON or YAML file, and confirmation of where the 'generated OpenAPI client' sources its spec from.
